podcast.title: Age at Garbage Debut (36)
podcast.body: When Garbage released their first album in 1995, bass player Steve Marker was 36 years old. "Bass player Steve Marker was 36."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation and Search for a Singer
xref.body: Garbage was formed by producers Butch Vig, Duke Erikson, and sound engineer Steve Marker, who specifically sought a female singer in the vein of Chrissie Hynde or Patty Smith, one who could sing in a lower register. "She was drafted into Garbage by three dudes, butch vig, the record producer, Duke Erickson, and another producer and sound engineer named Steve Marker."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Shirley Manson's Discovery
xref.body: Steve Marker discovered Shirley Manson singing with a Scottish band called Angel Fish after seeing her on television, leading to her being tracked down for the new project. "But then it was Steve Marker who turned on a TV and saw a Scottish band called Angel Fish and saw Shirley singing for them."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
